headline: VISUAL MIN IN DRILL CORE DOUBLES COWTRAIL HOLE TO 559M — CARIBOO ROSE + BRS COMPLETE PHASE 1 DRILL AND AIRBORNE GEOPHYSICS, BC PORPHYRY (TSXV:CRB, BRS)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Cariboo Rose Resources (TSXV:CRB)
snippet: Cariboo Rose Resources Ltd. (TSXV:CRB) and BRS Resources Ltd. (TSXV:BRS) announced July 6, 2026 completion of Phase 1 diamond drilling (4 holes, 1,293m total) and an airborne geophysical survey at the Cowtrail Copper-Gold Porphyry Project in south-central BC, with the final hole CT26-28 extended from its 250m planned depth all the way to 559m after visual mineralization was observed in drill core. Cowtrail is contiguous with Vizsla Copper's (TSXV:VCU) Woodjam and Redgold porphyry projects and sits 20km southeast of Imperial Metals' operating Mount Polley Mine — the doubling of drill depth on the final hole to follow visible mineralization is the key geological signal investors track ahead of assays, suggesting the drill hit a mineralised zone significantly wider than the initial target model.

headline: EQUINOX + ORLA SHAREHOLDERS VOTE JULY 22 — $18.5B COMBINED SENIOR GOLD PRODUCER WITH 1M+ OZ OUTPUT NEEDS APPROVAL BEFORE Q3 CLOSE (TSX:EQX, ORLA)
snippet: Equinox Gold Corp. (TSX:EQX) and Orla Mining Ltd. (TSX:ORLA) hold their special shareholder meetings July 22, 2026 — proxy voting deadline July 20 — to approve an all-share combination backed by Pierre Lassonde creating a new senior North American gold producer with combined 2026 production guidance exceeding one million ounces at an $18.5 billion combined market value. The deal requires 66⅔% approval from Orla shareholders and a simple majority from Equinox shareholders, with Canadian Competition Bureau clearance already secured; closing targeted Q3 2026. For investors holding either stock, the July 20 proxy deadline is the immediate action item as both boards unanimously recommend approval.

headline: EKATI MINE ON THE AUCTION BLOCK — DIAMOND PRICES COLLAPSE 74% AS BURGUNDY'S CCAA RUNS TO JULY 28, CANADA'S OLDEST DIAMOND MINE SEEKS BUYER (ASX:BDM)
snippet: Burgundy Diamond Mines Ltd. (ASX:BDM) and subsidiary Arctic Canadian Diamond Company Ltd. have been granted CCAA extension to July 28, 2026 with a court-supervised sale and investment solicitation process now underway for the Ekati Diamond Mine in Canada's Northwest Territories — the country's oldest diamond mine — after Ekati rough diamond prices collapsed 74% from $92/carat at end-2024 to $24/carat by late 2025, driven by US tariffs on jewelry imports and sustained weak global rough diamond demand. The case illustrates how downstream tariff policy on finished goods cascades directly to mine-gate pricing, and is worth tracking as a case study in commodity-chain tariff transmission for retail investors monitoring similar dynamics across base and precious metals.

headline: SABLE MAPS DUAL CU-AG AND AU-AG SOIL DOMAINS AT ZORRO BEFORE MAIDEN DRILL — 15.3 G/T AU IN SURFACE SAMPLES, SAN JUAN ARGENTINA (TSXV:SAE)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Sable Resources Ltd. (TSXV:SAE)
snippet: Sable Resources Ltd. (TSXV:SAE) expanded the copper-gold target footprint at its Zorro Project in San Juan, Argentina on July 6, 2026, following a 1,719-sample soil geochemistry program that delineated two spatially distinct but related mineralised domains — a Cu-Ag (Au-Bi-W) domain in the western half and an Au-Ag-Zn (As-Pb) domain in the eastern half — with the eastern boundary defined by a north-south dextral fault system yielding surface rock samples up to 15.3 g/t Au and 117 g/t Ag. Sable is targeting a maiden drill program at Zorro during H2 2026, with the dual-domain soil result expanding the drill-target inventory beyond the original Zorro Cu intrusion-related copper target to include a potentially high-grade epithermal gold-silver component.

headline: PHENOM GETS US FOREST SERVICE PERMIT FOR 26-HOLE NEVADA DRILL — 2.1KM CARLIN-STYLE GOLD ANOMALY UP TO 2.73 G/T AU READY FOR FIRST HOLES (TSXV:PHNM)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Phenom Resources Corp. (TSXV:PHNM)
snippet: Phenom Resources Corp. (TSXV:PHNM) received a Plan of Operation permit from the US Forest Service on July 6, 2026 to drill its Dobbin Project in Nevada — authorizing up to 26 diamond core holes from 13 drill sites plus 12 mechanical trenches targeting an 800-metre portion of a 2.1km × 200m gold soil anomaly with values up to 2.73 g/t Au, interpreted as a Carlin-style gold system in one of the world's most prolific gold belts. Energold Drilling is engaged and mobilizing, with the geological team in place; US Forest Service Plan of Operation permits are the primary federal approval milestone for drilling on National Forest land and their receipt clears the last regulatory hurdle before first holes.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GDX DOWN 5% IN SUMMER BUT SEASONAL DATA SAYS BUY — GOLD'S AUTUMN RALLY TARGET $4,400–$4,460 AS SETUP TURNS MOST BULLISH IN YEARS
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly gold stock analysis argues that the 2026 summer doldrums have compressed their damage into June and early July — with GDX down 5% and gold down 2.4% summer-to-date from early June levels — and that the correction has produced one of the best seasonal entry setups for gold equities in several years, with gold at its least-overbought levels since the current bull market began. Historical GDX seasonal data shows gold stocks average 0.4% in June, 1.4% in July, and 3.2% in August as autumn rally momentum builds; the analysis identifies $4,400–$4,460 as the primary gold target for the next leg, implying 6–7% upside from current levels and 12–18% for leveraged miners at the 2x–3x amplification ratio.

headline: S&P GLOBAL: COPPER SPECS AT 80TH PERCENTILE LONG AS EAST-WEST DIVIDE WIDENS — COMEX ARBITRAGE CLOSES, CHINA DEMAND DESTRUCTION SIGNALS UNWIND RISK
snippet: A July 1, 2026 S&P Global analysis found that copper speculative positioning on COMEX has reached its 80th percentile to the upside — approaching record levels — while the COMEX-LME arbitrage spread that drove US copper stockpiling has largely closed, removing the structural support for elevated Western prices. Analysts noted "completely opposing market views" as bearish Chinese physical buyers and bullish Western financial traders pull in opposite directions; China's downstream copper fabricators are reporting active demand destruction from high prices, a pattern that has historically preceded speculative long unwinding even when underlying fundamentals remain constructive. Goldman Sachs pegs copper fair value at $11,500/mt vs. current elevated spot — relevant context for junior copper developers modelling project economics.

headline: BATTERY METALS RECOVERY STALLS AS GLOBAL EV GROWTH SLUMPS TO 0.9% — LFP AT 50% MARKET SHARE SQUEEZES COBALT AND NICKEL OUT OF THE DEMAND STORY
snippet: A Mining.com column examines the growing disconnect between battery metals price recovery and underlying EV demand weakness: global EV sales grew just 0.9% year-on-year in January–May 2026 (North America down 25%, China down 15%), while LFP battery chemistry — which contains no cobalt or nickel — now commands 50% of all automotive battery market share, structurally limiting the demand recovery for those metals even as prices have rebounded from 2024–2025 lows. CME Group's battery metals complex did hit an all-time open interest record of 65,553 contracts on July 2, signalling that financial investors remain long the recovery thesis even as the physical demand story disappoints — a divergence that lithium and cobalt junior investors should watch carefully as it often resolves in favour of physical reality.

headline: US BREAKS CHINA RARE EARTH GRIP: USA RARE EARTH HITS $6M Q1 REVENUE FROM MAGNETS, MP MATERIALS RAMPS GM SUPPLY — TWO PLANTS, ONE SUPPLY CHAIN (NYSE:USAR, MP)
snippet: Two US rare earth magnet producers are simultaneously ramping commercial production following China's export control implementation: USA Rare Earth (NYSE:USAR) commissioned Phase 1a of its Stillwater, Oklahoma sintered NdFeB magnet facility in March 2026 and recorded $6 million in Q1 2026 sales from its rare earth metal business, while announcing a new Cherokee County, South Carolina expansion facility targeting 490 jobs; MP Materials (NYSE:MP) simultaneously began ramping NdFeB magnet supply for General Motors from its Fort Worth, Texas Independence facility and is commissioning a new heavy rare earth separation plant at Mountain Pass. The simultaneous activation of two domestic rare earth magnet supply chains — the first since Magnequench left Indiana in 1998 — is the structural shift that underpins the investment case for Western rare earth mining explorers positioning deposits to feed downstream demand.

headline: 7 GOLD MINERS POISED TO OUTPERFORM AS $4,155 GOLD TESTS TURNING POINT — PRODUCERS LEVERAGE METAL 2-3X, ANALYSTS FRAME ENTRY WINDOW (ANALYSIS)
snippet: An Investing.com analysis identifies seven gold mining stocks positioned to leverage the next directional move in gold as the metal trades at $4,155 after recovering 4% from its $3,993 June 24 correction low — noting that large-cap gold producers typically amplify gold's price moves by 2x to 3x through operating margin expansion as revenues rise against relatively fixed cost structures. The analysis frames the current setup as a meaningful entry window for mining equities: gold has recovered off its corrective base but remains 23% below the January 28 all-time high of $5,405, and the miner-metal divergence observed during the correction — where producers held relatively well against spot — historically precedes an acceleration phase in gold mining stock outperformance.
